styles.label: Cel bands
styles.description: Supersampled albedo + light passes: majority material per pixel, key light cut into 3 palette-ramp bands, then orphan cleanup and a 1px outline.

characters.label: Knight
characters.notes: Body without gear; sword, badge shield, plate harness with helmet and cape, and boots are layers. Base layers together are the Knight the harness renders.

characters.label: Shadow
characters.notes: Rogue_Hooded with a dagger. Body is the bare-headed Rogue; hood, cloak, dagger and boots are layers.

characters.label: Fireball Person
characters.notes: Mage with a staff and its own hat. Body is the bare Mage; staff, cape, hat and boots are layers.

characters.label: Skeleton
characters.notes: Skeleton_Minion with the pack's Skeleton_Blade.

characters.label: Villager
characters.notes: Barbarian, unarmed, holding a mug.

characters.label: Guard
characters.notes: Barbarian with an axe, the round shield and the bear-skin helm, so it does not read as the Knight.

characters.label: Robed Figure
characters.notes: Skeleton_Mage's robe with the Skeleton_Rogue hood pulled up.

gear.label: Harness of the Last Wall (Knight_Body + Skeleton_Warrior_Helmet + Rogue_Cape)
Boots of Speed (legs below the shin, gold)
Boots of Speed (legs below the shin, orange)
Mantle of the Third Sun (Rogue_Cape, sun colours)
Boots of Speed (legs below the shin, gold)

styles.label: Pixel artist
